owner: W1-10, from RI-WPN06 §A/§C/§D/§E. Stability, absorption and block stamina cost are RI-CMB03's and are NOT restated here. Parry windows are RI-CMB05's, cited through RI-WPN06 §D verbatim; this file is an agreement check, not a re-measurement.

configurations.note: RI-WPN06 §C. O1, O2 and O3 are mandatory. Switching between any pair must change the player's reachable verb count by >= 4 in each direction, which is measured by tools/weapons/measure.mjs and by the harness verb probe.

o1_sword_shield.note: The default. The only configuration with guard.counter, which is the shield's offensive verb.

o2_dual.note: Losing block is not negotiable (RI-WPN06 §C). Dual-wield trades the whole defensive half of the kit for an offensive chain; if it kept block it would strictly dominate O1 and the shield would stop existing.

o3_twohand.note: guard.counter is unavailable: it requires a raised shield to have been struck. 2h.guard.counter exists in the slot table because RI-WPN01 §A puts it in the mandatory 25, and it is reachable only in the transitional case where the player two-hands DURING the 40 f@60 guard-counter window opened by a block landed one-handed — which the 36 f@60 uncancellable stance switch makes a real, tight, and deliberately awkward option.

o5_bow.note: A class, not an offhand (RI-WPN06 §C O5).

greatshield_xanmeer.name: Xanmeer door
greatshield_xanmeer.note: Cannot parry, ever. RI-WPN06 hard-fails a greatshield that parries: the heaviest, most stable shield also getting the most powerful defensive verb collapses the taxonomy into a stat ladder.

parry_dagger.name: Parrying dirk
parry_dagger.note: No block at all. DGR, TSW and CSW held in the offhand behave as this row (RI-WPN06 §D).

guard_angle_rule.rule: An attack whose incoming direction lies OUTSIDE the shield's angle is not blocked at all: full damage, full poise damage, and NO stamina cost, exactly as though no shield were raised. Geometric and deterministic (ARBITRATION S1).
guard_angle_rule.why: It is what makes a greatshield's +/-95 deg worth its weight, and what makes turtling against a surrounding group fail.

shield.bash.note: The O1 guardbreak variant. Motion value is capped at 0.40 by RI-WPN06 M6: a shield that is a good weapon deletes the weapon.

shield.charge.note: Greatshield only. 2.60 m of root displacement — the greatshield's reason to exist.

stance_switch.why_not_instant: An instant, frame-zero toggle makes two-handing free in the middle of a fight, so the shield costs nothing and the offhand decision evaporates. RI-WPN06 hard-fails it.

dual_wield.chain: off.r1.1 -> off.r1.2 -> null, and off.r2 as the offhand heavy.
dual_wield.simultaneity: The two hands can never attack on the same frame. The offhand chain and the main-hand chain interleave no faster than the 8 f@60 input buffer allows (RI-WPN06 M7).
dual_wield.clips: off.* slots carry their own clip ids with their own pose profiles (the offhand mirror of the class's r1.2 / r1.1 / r2 families), so RI-WPN03's UNQ requirement extends to them as RI-WPN06 M7 demands.
